'''Imperial transport carriers'''<ref name="Databank">{{Databank|imperial-transport-carrier|Imperial transport carrier}}</ref> were used by the [[Galactic Empire]] as it built an armory in the center of [[Palmo]], the [[capital]] of [[Ghorman]]. They were repulsorlift-powered transports used to carry construction materials through Palmo's avenues.<ref name="Festive" />
